-- =================================================================
-- Description:	This gets a basic report for [EspacioExtra] table
-- =================================================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rpt_EspacioExtra_Index]
@EntityId AS INT = 0, 
@Espacio_Id AS INT = 0, 
@ConceptoFacturable_Id AS INT = 0
AS
BEGIN
	
	-- IMPORTANT:
	-- This is a computer generated procedure.  DO NOT ADD CUSTOM CODE TO THIS PROCEDURE.

	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	
	-- 1) CREATE FILTER TABLE:
	DECLARE @EspacioExtraFilter TABLE (
		Id INT IDENTITY (1,1),
		EspacioExtra_Id INT		
	)


    -- IF A GIVEN ID HAS BEEN SPECIFIED, THEN RETRIEVE THAT RECORD ONLY
	IF @EntityId <> 0
	BEGIN

		INSERT INTO @EspacioExtraFilter (EspacioExtra_Id)
		SELECT 
			[EspacioExtra].Id
		FROM [dbo].[EspacioExtra]
		WHERE
			 [dbo].[EspacioExtra].[Id] = @EntityId

	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN

		-- 2) FILTER BY FOREIGN RELATIONSHIPS WHEN APLICABLE:
		INSERT INTO @EspacioExtraFilter (EspacioExtra_Id)
		SELECT 
			[EspacioExtra].Id
		FROM [dbo].[EspacioExtra]
		WHERE
			 [EspacioExtra].[Activo] = 1 AND
         (([EspacioExtra].[Espacio_Id] = @Espacio_Id) OR (@Espacio_Id = 0)) AND
         (([EspacioExtra].[ConceptoFacturable_Id] = @ConceptoFacturable_Id) OR (@ConceptoFacturable_Id = 0))

 	END

 
	-- 4) DELIVER THE FILTERED RESULTS:
	SELECT 
		[EspacioExtra].[Id],
		[EspacioExtra].[Espacio_Id],
		[EspacioExtra].[ConceptoFacturable_Id],
		[EspacioExtra].[Activo],
		[EspacioExtra].[FechaDesactivacion],
		[EspacioExtra].[DesactivadoPor],
		[Espacio].[Nombre] AS [EspacioNombre],
		[Espacio].[Descripcion] AS [EspacioDescripcion],
		[ConceptoFacturable].[Concepto] AS [ConceptoFacturableConcepto],
		[ConceptoFacturable].[Descripcion] AS [ConceptoFacturableDescripcion],
		[EspacioExtra].[FechaCreacion],
		[EspacioExtra].[CreadoPor],
		[EspacioExtra].[FechaModificacion],
		[EspacioExtra].[ModificadoPor]
	FROM @EspacioExtraFilter filter
		JOIN [dbo].[EspacioExtra] 
			ON [EspacioExtra].[Id] = filter.[EspacioExtra_Id] 
			

		LEFT JOIN [dbo].[Espacio]
		ON [dbo].[EspacioExtra].[Espacio_Id] = [dbo].[Espacio].[Id] 

 		LEFT JOIN [dbo].[ConceptoFacturable]
		ON [dbo].[EspacioExtra].[ConceptoFacturable_Id] = [dbo].[ConceptoFacturable].[Id] 

 
END
